facts.text: Hickory Township was settled in 1798 and officially incorporated from Neshannock Township in 1859-1860.
The township proudly hosts the Lawrence County Fairgrounds and Spartan Park, blending serene agriculture with residential and light industrial zones.
A short ride north from Hickory opens the door to Amish country, the quaint village of Volant, and Westminster College in New Wilmington.
Township meetings convene the first Monday of every month at 7:00 p.m. in the municipal building on Eastbrook Road.
Hickory’s municipal office operates Monday through Thursday from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m., welcoming residents and visitors.
Hickory Township sits in Lawrence County, Pennsylvania, anchoring a mix of agriculture, residential, and conservation areas.
